findings.title: Web service is reachable
findings.evidence: Port 80/tcp is open and identified as nginx 1.18.0 on Ubuntu.
findings.remediation: Confirm the web service is intended to be reachable and keep nginx and the host operating system patched.

findings.title: SSH is exposed
findings.evidence: Port 22/tcp is open and identified as OpenSSH 8.9p1 Ubuntu.
findings.remediation: Limit SSH access to trusted sources and enforce key-based authentication.

findings.title: Limited attack surface observed
findings.evidence: Only SSH and HTTP were found open in this scan.
findings.remediation: Continue monitoring for unexpected service exposure and remove any services that are not required.

ai_summary.executive: The scan found one Linux web server with a small attack surface: SSH and an nginx HTTP service. The main follow-up is to confirm both services are intentionally reachable and protected by normal hardening controls.
